confidence_statement: Extraction envelopes are deterministic analysis bounds, not experimental standard deviations or 95% confidence intervals.

components.name: vector_digitization
components.unit: PDF point on each published axis
components.basis: Conservative combined symbol/tick-placement envelope, checked against the second parser and independent raster centres. CSV contains transformed per-axis bounds; logarithmic transformation is nonlinear.
components.limitations: Does not include source normalization inconsistency or experimental error.

components.name: axis_semantics
components.basis: Manual PDF/figure-context audit and repeated-figure checks; assignment performed by one analyst. Source ambiguities are listed separately, not erased by subpixel centres.

components.name: delta_d_Hh
components.basis: Hh is reported; delta is about 0.25m; rough d is an author assumption. Converted heights using delta/d are nominal; source uncertainty is not quantified.

components.name: measurement_system
components.basis: Reported pitch-voltage deviation <±1.5% in 1-8m/s is a calibration property, not a complete velocity or stress uncertainty budget.

components.name: finite_sampling
components.basis: 30 s at 1kHz, no raw series/autocorrelation. Do not infer 30000 independent samples or reconstruct confidence intervals from n alone.

components.name: dimensional_Reynolds
components.basis: Re_H values approximate; rough Re_s consistency differs ~1.8%. Absolute Uinf and nu are not separately reported.

components.name: facility_and_homogenization
components.basis: End plates/sidewall BL and local cube flow unresolved; ks is not the measured cube height.

components.name: CFD_numerical_and_sampling
components.basis: No CFD run in CV1; to be quantified by CV4 and each production case.

combination: Keep each contribution separate; no root-sum-square without a justified independence model.
reattachment_resolution: 10mm traverse spacing corresponds to 0.25Hh; half-spacing 0.125Hh may be reported as a spatial resolution indicator, not as total x_R uncertainty. The paper uses an unspecified extrapolation.
source_inconsistency_policy: Do not expand extraction error bars arbitrarily to absorb Fig.3(e) normalization mismatch. Flag it and retain the calibration priority/duplicate exclusion.
verdicts: Engineering error assessment with named missing uncertainties; formal 95% experimental support is inconclusive where the missing budget matters.
